title: Processes Related to Investigations into Political Office Holders and Civil Servants, and Updates on Recent Cases
what_it_is: Processes Related to Investigations into Political Office Holders and Civil Servants, and Updates on Recent Cases

sections.label: CPIB investigation and Prime Minister concurrence
sections.summary: Questions ask about the CPIB investigation timeline, reasons for the 11 July 2023 formal investigation, Iswaran's leave of absence, and whether CPIB needs the Prime Minister's concurrence.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
sentences.text: asked the Prime Minister (a) what is the timeline of the Corrupt Practices Investigation Bureau's (CPIB) uncovering of the matter relating to the investigation that Minister S Iswaran is assisting with; and (b) what are the reasons for commencing formal investigation on 11 July 2023 when the Prime Minister was briefed by the Director of CPIB on 5 July 2023 and gave his concurrence on 6 July 2023 to open a formal investigation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
sentences.text: asked the Prime Minister whether CPIB’s investigation which Minister S Iswaran is assisting with pertains to actions or decisions taken in the course of his official duties or to matters which he has had purview over in his official capacity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Don Wee
sentences.text: asked the Prime Minister why has Minister S Iswaran been placed on a leave of absence while assisting CPIB with an investigation, whereas Minister K Shanmugam and Minister Vivian Balakrishnan continued with their duties while assisting with CPIB investigations regarding their rental of state properties at Ridout Road.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
sentences.text: asked the Prime Minister (a) whether CPIB is obligated to seek the Prime Minister's concurrence to open formal investigations on potential offences that CPIB has uncovered; (b) if so, under what circumstances or cases will CPIB be obligated to seek such concurrence; (c) whether the Prime Minister's power to give or refuse concurrence to CPIB is circumscribed or open-ended; (d) whether there are occasions where the Prime Minister has declined permission for CPIB to investigate a matter and, if so, what are these circumstances.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
sentences.text: asked the Prime Minister (a) whether all investigations by CPIB require the Prime Minister's concurrence; (b) if not, what type of investigations require the Prime Minister's concurrence; and (c) why the investigations under part (b) require the Prime Minister's concurrence.

sections.label: CPIB media releases on Iswaran arrest
sections.summary: A question asks why CPIB's 12 July 2023 media release described Iswaran as assisting with an investigation without mentioning his arrest the day before.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
sentences.text: asked the Prime Minister regarding CPIB's update to the media on 14 July 2023 that Minister S Iswaran had been arrested on 11 July 2023, what are the reasons for the earlier CPIB media release on 12 July 2023 describing Minister S Iswaran as assisting with an investigation without mention of him having been arrested the day before.

sections.label: Iswaran arrest disclosure and leave of absence
sections.summary: Questions ask how many individuals CPIB arrested over Iswaran, why his 11 July 2023 arrest was disclosed on 14 July 2023, and whether his 7 to 9 July 2023 leave relates to the investigation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
sentences.text: asked the Prime Minister (a) to date, how many individuals have been arrested by CPIB in relation to the investigation into Mr S Iswaran; and (b) why is the arrest of Mr S Iswaran on 11 July 2023 not disclosed until 14 July 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
sentences.text: asked the Prime Minister (a) whether Mr S Iswaran’s leave of absence from his duties from 7 to 9 July 2023, as notified in the Government Gazette No 2017 on 14 July 2023, is related to the investigation of CPIB; and (b) if so, whether he has discharged any official duties or attended any official meetings during that period of leave of absence.
